items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 89:1
items.html: They rose to the phase of the GAR of their own, and became there new GAR of AVA, and the GAR of their own rose still higher, for this is the rule, that it is impossible for any ascent to happen to a lower Partzuf, unless all those above it ascend first. As is known in the secret of the ascents of the Sabbath. (Item 920, item 87)
